# C# Playground

> Browser-only C# playground built with Blazor WebAssembly and Roslyn. Embeddable in blogs and documentation via iframe; no backend API.

## Primary

- [AI and agent integration](AGENTS.md): canonical URL, iframe rules, Playwright selectors, limitations.
- [Live site](https://csharp-roslyn-wasm-playground.pages.dev/): default .NET 10 runtime.
- [.NET 8 runtime](https://csharp-roslyn-wasm-playground.pages.dev/net8/)
- [.NET 9 runtime](https://csharp-roslyn-wasm-playground.pages.dev/net9/)
- [.NET 10 runtime](https://csharp-roslyn-wasm-playground.pages.dev/net10/)

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](documentation/README.md)
- [Iframe style API](documentation/iframe-style-api.md)
- [Browser C# runtime](documentation/browser-runtime.md)
- [Console API](documentation/console-api.md)
- [Runtime versions](documentation/runtimes.md)
- [Target framework selection](documentation/target-frameworks.md)
- [Deployment guide](documentation/deployment.md)

## Notes

- No HTTP compile/run API. Validate examples with Playwright if needed.
- Use `completion=manual` and `loading="lazy"` for blog embeds.
- Use `domcontentloaded` rather than `networkidle` when automating.
